about: SSOT: the (job, check step) pairs whose failure is a deterministic red.
A job counts as deterministically red ONLY when it failed AT its named check
step. A failure in any other step (checkout, toolchain install, sccache,
rust-cache, setup-mold, crate fetch, a regenerate/build step) or a skipped
job behind a failed ancestor is infra-shaped and never counts.
context = the job's status context exactly as `gh api .../jobs` reports it
(its `name:`, or its job id when unset); step = that job's check step
`name:` in ci.yml, byte-exact. The check step must be network-free: same
Consumer: ci.yml `cancel-on-cheap-red` (its `needs:` is exactly these jobs;
it cancels only on a matched pair). ci/verify-manifest.py validates shape,
the needs: set, and every step name against ci.yml.
